verdict.rationale: The evidence pack only shows API/developer capabilities (uploads, permissions, properties, building custom agent add-ons via ADK/Vertex AI) but no built-in AI assistant inside Google Drive itself that a user can delegate tasks to. Missing for 10: any mention of a native in-product assistant (e.g., Gemini in Drive) accessible to end users, evidence of task delegation UI, or hands-on confirmation of such a feature.
